common.tagline: A full trip plan in 3 minutes
common.comingSoonBody: This part is built in the next development phase. Meanwhile, head back home.
common.demoBanner: Demo mode: routing, weather and holidays come from free, key-less sources. Estimated data is labelled.
common.offline: No internet connection. Saved plans are available under "My trips".

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: No password: we email you a link. An account keeps your trips in the cloud, syncs them between devices and lets you plan together.
auth.sentBody: Check the inbox of {email} and click the link. It is valid for 24 hours.
auth.demoNote: Demo mode: no email service is configured, so the link is shown here instead of being sent. In the real setup it arrives by email.
auth.guestHint: No account needed: you can carry on as a guest, and trips are kept on this device only. After signing in they move to the account automatically.

profile.title: My profile
profile.subtitle: The preferences that repeat on every trip, so the questionnaire fills itself in.
profile.guestNote: The profile is kept on this device. Signing in stores it in the cloud and syncs it between devices.
profile.name: Name
profile.defaultsHint: Every new trip starts from these answers. You can change them in any questionnaire.
profile.visitedHint: Attractions you marked "already visited" in a plan. They are left out of future trips.
profile.visitedEmpty: Nothing yet. In a plan, every attraction's menu has "Already visited".

journal.subtitle: A few words about each day and a rating. Saved with the trip, and synced to your account if you signed in.
journal.noPlan: The journal opens once a plan is built.
journal.dayPlaceholder: What happened? What surprised you? What would you change?
journal.summaryPlaceholder: Tips for next time, for you or for friends.
journal.privacy: The journal is private. It is not included in share links.

home.heroTitle: From a dream to a day-by-day plan, in 3 minutes
home.heroSubtitle: Answer a short questionnaire and Triplan builds your trip day by day and hour by hour, fitted to your pace, ages, transport and opening hours.

fit.title: Fitted to who travels
fit.body: A family with a baby, a couple in their 70s, or sporty travelers on their third visit: every plan is built from scratch for the people going.

honest.title: Transparent and honest
honest.body: Every placement has a reason: "12 minutes walk from the hotel", "open on Saturday". Whatever is unverified is marked.

offline.title: Works in the field
offline.body: The plan, the map and the addresses work without internet, on your phone, like an app.

1.title: Answer 10 questions
1.body: Destination, dates, who travels, pace, transport, budget and hotel. Every question has a smart default.

2.title: Get a plan
2.body: Day by day, hour by hour, with walking distance, a rain plan and alternatives.

3.title: Edit and go
3.body: Drag, swap, lock. Export to PDF and calendar, and share with your travel partners.

home.statusBody: Triplan is built in phases. Working today: questionnaire, planning engine, four views, map, export, offline, 12 languages, accounts and planning together. The AI assistant needs an Anthropic key.

plan.failed: We could not build a plan. {message}

about.booking: The world's largest booking site for hotels and apartments. Free cancellation on most offers; opens on your city and dates.
about.hotelscom: Expedia Group's hotel site with a loyalty program (one free night per ten).
about.agoda: Especially strong in Asia, often the lowest prices for Japan and Thailand.
about.hostelworld: The main site for hostels and budget stays, with reviews by young travellers.
about.getyourguide: Tickets for attractions and guided tours, usually with skip-the-line entry.
about.viator: Tours and experiences by TripAdvisor, a huge selection.
about.tiqets: Digital tickets for museums and attractions, good for last-minute buys.
about.klook: Asian site for tickets, rail passes and SIM cards, strong in Japan and the Far East.
about.kiwi: Flight search that combines different airlines (low-cost too) into one ticket.
about.skyscanner: Flight price comparison across all airlines, including whole-month search.
about.rentalcars: Car rental from the Booking group, comparing local and international companies with free cancellation.
about.discovercars: Car rental comparison with ratings of the local companies and cheap full-coverage insurance.
about.ticketmaster: Tickets for concerts, sports and theatre; search by city.
about.eventbrite: Local events, workshops and parties, many of them free.
about.songkick: Concert listings by city and date.
about.residentadvisor: The main listing for clubs and electronic music nights worldwide.
about.googleflights: Google's flight search: fast, every airline, flexible dates. No affiliate program.
about.kayak: Long-standing comparison site of the Booking group, with a price graph by day. Opens with the adults; add children on the site.
about.momondo: European comparison engine from the same group as Kayak, good for cheap flights within Europe.
about.tripcom: Large online agency from China, often low fares to Asia and for domestic flights in Japan.

lisbon-family-5.title: Lisbon and Sintra with kids
lisbon-family-5.body: 5 days, two school-age children, moderate pace, public transport, an apartment in the centre.

rome-first-time-4.title: Rome for the first time
rome-first-time-4.body: 4 intense days for a couple: the classics, museums, food and photography.

tokyo-week-7.title: A week in Tokyo and Kamakura
tokyo-week-7.body: 7 days for a couple: city, food, shopping, history and nature, hotel by a station.

porto-lisbon-relaxed-6.title: Porto and Lisbon, unhurried
porto-lisbon-relaxed-6.body: 6 days for a couple aged 65+: little walking, wine and food, guided tours, boutique hotels.

lisbon-beach-7.title: Beach holiday in Lisbon

disclosure.title: Disclosure
disclosure.intro: Triplan shows links to external booking sites: hotels, attraction tickets and flights.
disclosure.affiliate: Some of these links are affiliate links. If you book through them, Triplan may earn a small commission. Your price does not change.
disclosure.marking: Every such link is labeled "Affiliate link" in the interface and opens in a new tab.
disclosure.data: Attraction data that has not been verified is labeled "unverified". Check opening hours and prices before you go.
disclosure.noKeys: There are currently no active affiliate keys, and the links are plain search links.
disclosure.partnersIntro: Every link opens on the trip's city, dates and number of travellers. These are the sites and what each one does:

explore.body: A full route from morning to evening, at least 4 places a day.

relax.title: Beach holiday

chat.needsKey: The assistant needs an Anthropic key
chat.needsKeyBody: Once ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set on the server you can type free requests here ("make day 2 lighter", "swap the museum for something outdoors") and the assistant proposes structured changes to the plan. Without a key, every button in the plan does the same things by hand.
chat.noPlan: The assistant works on an existing plan. Build one first.
chat.intro: Say what to change. The assistant ({model}) proposes structured operations, which go through the regular editing engine.
chat.examples: Examples: "day 2 is too busy", "move the Colosseum to day 3", "swap the museum for something outdoors", "drop all the shopping".
chat.placeholder: What should change in the plan?
chat.disclaimer: The assistant never invents places: it only picks from attractions the engine knows, and every change passes the same checks as a manual edit.
